title: 15th Annual Joplin Turkey Trot 5K & 1 Mile Fun Run -Thanksgiving - 11/26/2026
seo_title: 15th Annual Joplin Turkey Trot 5K & 1 Mile Fun Run
description: This is the 15th annual Thanksgiving morning 5K run/walk and 1 mile fun run in downtown Joplin, presented by Freeman Health System. The certified 5K course starts and ends in front of the Schroeder Family Exploreum on roads closed to traffic, and 5K participants receive an event shirt, finisher medal, chip timing, music, and donuts and coffee. It takes place on November 26, 2026 in Joplin, MO, with the 1 Mile Fun Run at 7:30 AM and the 5K at 8:00 AM; be at the start line at least 10 minutes early.
